# decision-002: CLI and Telegram handlers must acquire media through one MediaService validation and atomic-library-publication path.

- Status: `implemented`
- Freshness: `stable`
- Area: `architecture`
- Recorded: `2026-10-16`
- Last verified: `2026-10-16`
- Tags: `acquisition`, `ffmpeg`, `media-service`, `validation`
- Scope: Local library retains byte validation; PR 38 adds explicit hosted metadata acceptance (source-143).

## Rationale and consequences

The shared path owns acquisition, metadata policy, playback validation, cache integrity, and atomic publication. Handlers consume only validated LibraryItem paths and never upload after failed validation.
